mentions.name: FreeBSD Driver Development self-study
mentions.description: A personal self-study project of working through a FreeBSD Driver Development book to get back into low-level systems programming, including testing the book's examples (with UTM and the aarch64 ISO on Apple Silicon instead of the suggested VirtualBox setup) and planning to eventually contribute to hardware ideas.
mentions.source_excerpt: So, this is my hobby for a while. Go back to where I started, get into low-level systems programming again, I have some ideas on some hardware I want to help out on
